title: Earth mass expression
description: Essential: Student must derive or state the correct expression for Earth's mass: M = gR²/G.

title: Centripetal acceleration derivation
description: Important: Student must correctly apply Newton's law of gravitation and second law to derive a = gR²/(R+h)².

title: Orbital speed derivation
description: Important: Student must correctly equate gravitational force to centripetal force to derive v = R√[g/(R+h)].

title: Correct force identification
description: Important: Student must identify that gravitational force provides the centripetal force for the satellite.

title: Surface gravity relation
description: Optional: Student may explicitly show the substitution g = GM/R² when deriving satellite motion expressions.

title: Units or dimensional check
description: Optional: Student may include unit analysis or dimensional consistency verification of final expressions.

title: Incorrect radius usage
description: Pitfall: Student uses Earth radius R instead of orbital radius (R+h) in gravitational force expression for satellite.

title: Algebraic manipulation errors
description: Pitfall: Student makes algebraic errors when solving for acceleration or velocity from force equations.
